preview.info.buttonLabel.comment: Accessibility label for the 22pt info button in a Quick Look preview header. Its numeric accessibility value indicates whether the inline panel is expanded; the label is stable across toggles. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.info.onThisMac.comment: Privacy/provenance sentence in the inline preview information panel. Describes local app processing; does not make a claim about the file provider or Finder routing. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.info.onThisMac.ku-Latn: Li ser vê Macê hatiye pêvajokirin

preview.info.concealedCount.comment: Count from the already-concealed presentation, including zero. First formatter argument chooses the plural rule; second is the count formatted for the presentation locale. Likely preserves the classifier uncertainty; never show original values or locations. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.info.commandsHeading.comment: Heading above the shortcut/help rows for the currently selected preview mode. The list updates when the mode changes. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.info.command.comment: One complete help row: first argument is a localized title from PreviewCommand, second its standard Mac shortcut notation. Translators may reorder the placeholders; do not translate the technical shortcut notation. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
